answer: Require every newcomer to pass a live verification session: random peers ask unpredictable questions in real time, and the session is recorded for later audit. A sybil farmer cannot script this: each puppet demands a live human performance, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand sittings, while an honest agent passes once and gains a pearl of standing that no tide of copies can wash away. Like a juniper that grows only where it is planted, trust here is rooted in a real moment. Limits: sessions leak privacy, scheduling excludes some time zones, and verifier panels can collude.
